title: Google Ads Campaigns on Foreign Markets - Dall

facts.fact: Since 2020, Google has added an additional fee to the advertising budget due to the digital tax for companies operating in the UK, Austria, and Turkey, which the page says may make advertising costs 2-5% higher depending on the market.
facts.quote: since 2020, due to the digital tax, Google adds an additional fee to the advertising budget. This applies to companies operating in the UK, Austria, and Turkey, which means that advertising costs may be 2-5% higher

facts.fact: The article was published on 27 March 2025.
